title: BEDTIME PRAYER FOR
A STILL HEART
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day

scenes.a: If an unspoken anger from today is still pacing through your mind, stay right here.
Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still.
I bring every lingering grievance and sharp thought into your peaceful presence.
Silence the urge to replay today's battles in the dark.
laying down every resentment before I sleep.
wrap me in your deep rest tonight.

captions: If an unspoken anger from today is still pacing through your mind, stay right here. God’s word speaks into your quiet room:
Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still.
Heavenly Father, as night falls, I bring every lingering grievance and sharp thought into your peaceful presence.
Silence the urge to replay today's battles in the dark. Let awe of your greatness replace my quiet irritation.
I yield this restless heart to your care, laying down every resentment before I sleep.
Guard my mind, quiet my soul, and wrap me in your deep rest tonight. Amen. Subscribe for daily night prayers.
